name: IGAT 5 Gas Pipeline

values.OtherEnglishNames: Iran Gas Trunkline 5, IGAT V, IGAT-5
values.RouteNotes: Corridor Assaluyeh (South Pars Gas Complex, Bushehr) to Agha Jari Gas Injection Station (Behbahan, Khuzestan), ~504 km, five compressor stations; carries sour gas from South Pars phases 6-8 for oil-well injection. No verified official GeoJSON in routes repo; endpoints well-sourced but route unmapped.

researcher_notes: Re-checked match-to-existing against all 42 Iran gas rows: roster holds IGAT 1,2,3,4,6,7,8,9,10,11 but NO IGAT 5 (nearest, P6006 Behbahan-Gachsaran 62km/20in, is a different line). Genuine gap, no PID collision. IGAT 5 is a real, long-operating trunkline distinct from the others by route and function: it carries sour gas from South Pars phases 6-8 (Assaluyeh, Bushehr) to the Aghajari gas-injection station (Behbahan, Khuzestan) for oil-well injection, not distribution. Add-threshold met easily: (a) sponsor = NIGC / Iran Ministry of Petroleum; (b) endpoints + provinces known; (c) built and operating. Confidence HIGH on physical attrs: OGJ states verbatim 'The 56-in. IGAT V trunkline will carry 75 million cu m/day of sour gas from South Pars Phases 6-8 to Khoozestan oil fields for injection. It will connect Assaluye and Agha Jari, a distance of 504 km, and will have five compressor stations.' Independently corroborated by Wikipedia Iran Gas Trunkline (IGAT5, 56 in, sour gas from phases 6/7/8 to Khuzestan for oil-well injection, listed operating) and Offshore Magazine (Aghajari injection fed by South Pars phases 6-8). Capacity: 75 MMcm/d design flow converted to 27.4 bcm/y to match GEM CapacityUnits (75 x 365 / 1000). Owner/Parent inherited from existing IGAT-row convention (Ministry of Petroleum / NIGC) rather than a new entity. Route: no verified official GeoJSON confirmed in the routes repo; a commercial GIS product (digital-oil-gas-map) exists but not used to claim a mapped route -- RouteType/RouteAccuracy left unset, corridor documented in RouteNotes for a later human route pass. All 4 URLs passed scripts/url_verifier.py; none are GEM/theodora/wikidot. Independent sources >=2 (OGJ + Offshore Magazine + Wikipedia, distinct originators).
